protocol: Phase-C learned realizer (M4-lite at data scale): word-LSTM trained on a REAL Wikidata corpus (P31/P106/P17).  Scoring-based generation: rank the paraphrase bank across all relations by the realizer's log-likelihood, pick the most natural. Pass: honesty >= 0.9, round-trip >= 0.8, fluency > template >= 0.5, relation-appropriate >= 0.5, 3 seeds.

sample: a is classified as a human
the country of Algeria is Algeria
a #queer revolution morocco counts as a hashtag
the occupation of basketball player is basketball player

verdict: PHASE-C PASS: a learned realizer trained on REAL Wikidata knowledge ranks grounded phrasings by learned naturalness (scoring-based generation) -- honest (only the M-rep's entities), round-trip (recovers subject/object), relation-appropriate, more fluent than the fixed template. The scalable learning layer's first brick. (Free auto-regressive decode is shown as a qualitative sample; it is imperfect at this small scale -- the full 0.1-0.3B realizer is phase-4 M4.)
